sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
An old note left by the surgeon Dosaku:
My disciples have abandoned me for Dogen. Unwilling to dirty their own hands, they all left me for that hypocritical quack. Dojun! My last disciple! Even if I die, the research must continue. Finish the procedure, for Ashina's sake!
Dosaku

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This item can only be obtained after defeating the Corrupted Monk of Mibu Village and obtaining the Mibu Breathing Technique, as the room it's found in has to be accessed via an underwater tunnel in the nearby body of water next to the Underground Waterway Sculptor's Idol.
